verdict.rationale: Asana documents multiple mechanisms for preserving context across tools/agents: an official MCP server that brings the 'work graph' into Claude/ChatGPT conversations, AI Teammates with 'shared memory' that carries forward completed work and feedback, and a large integration directory (Slack, GitHub, Jira, Salesforce, etc.) that syncs tasks/context bidirectionally, plus webhooks and a REST API for custom handoffs. These are first-party marketing/docs claims without independent hands-on verification that context is never lost in practice. Missing for 10: independent/third-party validation of lossless handoff, concrete before/after examples of context preservation, and evidence addressing edge cases where sync/integration might drop information.
